---
title: Pecorino with Garlic and Parsley
id: MAR-0058
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 160 g pitted black olives
- 60 g butter
- 1 tablespoon breadcrumbs
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
- to taste Salt and pepper
## Method
1. Put the olives in the blender, add the lemon juice, breadcrumbs, oil and a generous grind of pepper.
2. Blend until smooth.
3. Work the butter at room temperature with a fork until soft.
4. Pour the olive mixture over the butter and continue mixing, blending well; finally adjust salt.
5. Line a mold with wax paper, pour in the olive paté, seal with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
6. Pecorino with Garlic and Parsley
